title: Audioman Dump Result
description: Output envelope for `audioman dump` (always machine-readable; --json is implied). Single mode emits the plugin state object; `--all` emits one JSONL record per plugin, each carrying `batch: true` — a successful state record or a failure record with `error`.

format.description: Single-mode and batch-success state record only.

identifier.description: Single-mode and batch-success state record only.

version.description: Single-mode and batch-success state record only.

parameter_count.description: Single-mode and batch-success state record only.

parameters.description: Single-mode and batch-success state record only; parameter name -> bool/float/string/null.

saved_as_preset.description: Single mode only, when --save-preset was given.
